title: Account welcome in a landscape
slide_intent: Pair an international promise with an open setting so a digital service feels usable beyond a desk.
strategic_value: The globe, account headline and green action on a hand-held phone can give Wise’s global premise a concrete entry point.
demonstration: A hand holds a phone displaying a globe illustration, The World’s Money Account headline and login controls against a softly focused outdoor landscape.
practical_value: Check whether the entry screen communicates its proposition at the scale of a real device.

content_islands.name: Phone hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Stack globe, headline, supporting copy and actions within the screen.

content_islands.name: Outdoor context
content_islands.spec: Keep the hand and distant landscape visible without competing with the display.
